title: Place each declared contract schema file at the path its artifact identity spells out

facts.note: The validator runs when the plan is confirmed and blocks confirmation. Needs a phase observer.

values: plan/wagon produced-artifact declaration with a contract field
facts.note: Produced-artifact declarations in planner-authored files can be parsed. Every one that declares a concrete schema file is in scope, whether or not it changed in this edit. The source has no change-only restriction.
The declared contract is a concrete .schema.json file, wherever it currently sits. A file outside contracts/ is in scope and is a violation.

fires: At CONFIRM, a plan declares a produced artifact whose contract is a concrete .schema.json file, whether it is new, edited or unchanged.
A produced artifact's concrete .schema.json contract sits outside contracts/ or under directories that do not match its identity.
A planner renames an artifact identity (an identity-only edit) and leaves the contract path as it was.
doesNotFire: The artifact's contract physical form is a directory reference, not a .schema.json file.

given: A plan declares a produced artifact with an identity (theme:segment[:...][.segment]) and a concrete contract .schema.json file. This holds whether the declaration is new, edited (including identity-only renames) or unchanged.
when: You author, edit or confirm a plan that contains such a declaration.
then: Make the contract path mirror the identity exactly: every ':' and '.' boundary becomes a directory boundary under contracts/, and the leaf is the <aspect>.schema.json file (contracts/{theme}/.../{aspect}.schema.json).
prefer: Derive the path mechanically: split the identity on ':' and '.', turn the segments into directories under contracts/, and put the .schema.json leaf last.
When you rename an identity, update the contract path in the same edit (and the reverse).
avoid: Putting a .schema.json outside contracts/, or under a directory that does not match an identity segment (an extra, missing or renamed folder). A mis-located .schema.json is a violation.
Picking a convenient or grouped folder layout that breaks the identity→path mapping.
Treating an existing, unchanged mis-pathed contract as out of scope.
unless: The artifact's contract is null. Out of scope.
The contract's physical form is a directory reference, not a .schema.json file. Out of scope.
why: When the path is derived from the identity, a contract file can be found from its identity without guessing. A mis-located schema blocks plan confirmation.
evidence: For each produced artifact with a concrete .schema.json contract, the declared contract_path equals the path derived from its identity.
The CONFIRM-phase validator reports no mis-pathed contracts. It is confirm-blocking, and each failure reports artifact_name, contract_path and reason.
verifier_detail: Mapping: split the identity on ':' and '.'. The segments are directories under contracts/, and the leaf is the .schema.json file.
Correct (from source): match:config -> contracts/match/config/config.schema.json (a two-segment identity: the leaf name also appears as the final directory).

Skip only artifacts whose contract is null or whose physical form is a directory reference. Every other concrete .schema.json contract is checked, including unchanged ones and ones outside contracts/. A mis-located .schema.json is a violation.
Failure evidence fields: artifact_name, contract_path, reason.
audit: name: Contract path mirrors artifact identity
term_id: artifact_path_mirrors_identity — 'the path-mirrors-identity rule for a produced contract file'
